question: Is the rainfall-associated 0-to-CallingIndex-2/3 recruitment signal controlled by any single NAAMP state?
endpoint: strong_new_score = sum wet CallingIndex for cells dry=0 and wet in {2,3}.
model: Existing matched-pair model with rain_contrast, temperature_difference, day_of_year_difference, year_gap, State and RunNumber; route-clustered covariance.
audit: Refit after omitting each of the 21 states in turn.
strong_pass_rule: All 21 leave-one-state-out 95% confidence intervals remain entirely >0.
interpretation: Pass supports geographic robustness across the sampled NAAMP region, not universality or occurrence in every state.
